CustomObject.description: Engine-health snapshot. The watchdog sweep publishes it when Revenant_Config__mdt.Publish_Metrics_Events__c is on. Metrics_Json__c holds the counts for each workflow definition. A large snapshot uses more than one event with the same Snapshot_Id__c. Delivery is at-least-once. Dedupe on Snapshot_Id__c + Chunk_Index__c. Contract: docs/workflow-metrics-event.md.
CustomObject.label: Workflow Metrics
